description:
Initiate authentication flow for a connector.

For OAuth2 connectors, returns an authorization URL.
For API key connectors, stores the provided key.
For webhook connectors, registers the webhook URL.

apiKey.description: API key (for api_key auth strategy connectors)

botToken.description: Bot token (for bot_token auth strategy connectors like Telegram, Discord)

webhookUrl.description: Webhook URL (for webhook auth strategy connectors)

name: connect_connector
title: Connect a Connector
